Terms of Use

Rules for using NovelHaven, including personal reading access, account responsibilities, intellectual property, and third-party services.

Reading access

NovelHaven provides browsing, bookmarking, account, and reading features for personal use. You may not scrape, mass-copy, resell, republish, or redistribute chapter text, images, or other protected material without permission from the relevant rights holder.

Accounts

You are responsible for activity performed through your account and for maintaining control of the Google account used to sign in. NovelHaven may change, suspend, or discontinue account features when necessary for security, reliability, or maintenance.

Intellectual property

NovelHaven branding, original editorial writing, interface text, and original site code or design elements are protected by their applicable rights. Individual novels, covers, and third-party materials remain the property of their respective rights holders unless otherwise stated.

External services and links

NovelHaven may rely on or link to services operated by other companies. Those services have their own terms and privacy practices.

Availability and accuracy

Novel information, chapter counts, status labels, and availability can change. NovelHaven aims to keep listings accurate but does not guarantee uninterrupted access or that every catalog detail will always be error-free.

Changes to these terms

These terms may be revised as NovelHaven adds new features, advertising, or account services. Continued use after an update means you accept the revised terms.
